jobs.title: Product Manager, Ecosystem
jobs.description:
FloQast is at the forefront of the accounting industry, providing an AI-powered Accounting Transformation Platform created by accountants, for accountants. We are dedicated to revolutionizing how accounting and finance teams work, enabling them to move beyond manual, tedious tasks and into a strategic, advisory role. By leveraging our groundbreaking, auditable AI Agents and purpose-built solutions, we empower teams to streamline their financial close, enhance compliance, and achieve a new level of transparency and accuracy. Our mission is to help accountants reclaim their time, simplify their work, and ultimately shape the future of their profession. Come join us!
 
You will own ecosystem integration priorities end to end: researching source systems, defining integration requirements, mapping data into FloQast's data platform, and working across Product, Alliances, Engineering, and Services to get integrations into production. You should be comfortable going deep on data schemas and connectivity patterns, and equally comfortable presenting the business case for an integration or explaining its value to a customer.
 
Visa sponsorship is NOT available at this time

What You'll Do:
- Define ecosystem integration priorities: evaluate which source systems deliver the most customer value, and align the integration roadmap with product strategy and partnership goals.

- Evaluate source systems - subledgers and billing platforms, banks and treasury systems, payroll providers,, T&E platforms,, and others - understanding their data schemas, connectivity patterns, and relevance to FloQast accounting workflows.

- Drive the technical definition of integrations: connectivity approach (sFTP, API, data sharing), source data structure, mapping requirements, and how data flows into FloQast's canonical data models via the Data Platform.

- Map source data into FloQast's canonical schemas using FloQast’s Data Studio, ensuring data is accurately normalized and ready for use across FloQast applications.

- Build source system playbooks and workflow guidance so customers and implementation teams extract value from integrations faster.

- Align with Product and Alliances teams on ecosystem priorities, partnership opportunities, and integration roadmap sequencing.

- Support GTM teams with the story of FloQast-ecosystem value: what each integration unlocks, what customer problems it solves, and how it extends the platform.

- Collaborate with Engineering, Data Migration Engineers, Implementation, Customer Success, and Support to turn integration designs into working, production-grade data flows.

- Provide N-tier support for customers during onboarding and ongoing operations, troubleshooting integration, mapping, and data issues.

- Scale integration patterns and documentation so new source systems can be onboarded faster and more consistently over time.
What You'll Bring:
- 3+ years in product management or solutions consulting in technical fields such as systems integration, finance & accounting, analytics or similar

- Working proficiency in data querying, advanced Excel skills, and large structured & semi-structured data

- Experience with data pipelines, APIs, ETL workflows, iPaaS, data relationships and mapping

- Strong cross-functional communication skills and the ability to work effectively across customers, partners, Engineering, Product, Implementation, and Customer Success.

- Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly without close oversight.

- A practical, ownership-oriented mindset with a bias toward getting working integrations into production.
Nice To Have:
- Familiarity with ecosystem source systems relevant to accounting workflows: subledgers and billing platforms, banks and treasury systems, payroll providers, or T&E platforms.

- Working knowledge of accounting and financial data - enough to recognize when balances, hierarchies, or data relationships do not make business sense.

- Experience in a model-driven or metadata-driven data platform where source data is mapped, normalized, and published into reusable application-ready models.

- Product management experience, or experience working closely with product teams to translate technical integration knowledge into requirements and roadmap decisions.
#LI-SB1
 
This job posting is for our Product Manager, the base pay range for this position is $116,000 - 216,000.  Compensation is not limited to base salary. FloQast values our Total Rewards, and offers a competitive and elaborate Benefits Package including, but not limited to, Medical, Dental, Vision, Family Forming benefits, Life & Disability Insurance, and Unlimited Vacation.  FloQast reserves the right to amend, change, alter, and revise pay ranges and benefits offerings at any time. All applicants acknowledge that by applying to this position you understand that this specific pay range is contingent upon meeting the qualifications and requirements of the role, and for the successful completion of the interview selection and process. It is at the Company's discretion to determine what pay is provided to a candidate within the range associated with the role.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, SAP
jobs.description:
FloQast is at the forefront of the accounting industry, providing an AI-powered Accounting Transformation Platform created by accountants, for accountants. We are dedicated to revolutionizing how accounting and finance teams work, enabling them to move beyond manual, tedious tasks and into a strategic, advisory role. By leveraging our groundbreaking, auditable AI Agents and purpose-built solutions, we empower teams to streamline their financial close, enhance compliance, and achieve a new level of transparency and accuracy. Our mission is to help accountants reclaim their time, simplify their work, and ultimately shape the future of their profession. Come join us!
FloQast's SAP integration is central to making FloQast the home base for accountants at SAP-running companies. You will own the product strategy and execution for that integration - ensuring FloQast workflows, playbooks, and products run cleanly on SAP data and processes. You will operate at the intersection of deep SAP technical knowledge and accounting domain expertise, working across Product, Engineering, customers, and GTM to drive adoption and expand FloQast's footprint in the SAP ecosystem.
Visa sponsorship is NOT available at this time

What You'll Do
-
Define and drive product functionality for FloQast's SAP integration, ensuring FloQast workflows, playbooks, and products are fully enabled by SAP financial data and processes.

-
Own the end-to-end integration design: connectivity patterns, data extraction methods (ABAP, oData, BTP), and how SAP financial data maps into FloQast's canonical models.

-
Navigate SAP deployment models — On-Premise, Private Cloud, Public Cloud (RISE/GROW), and HEC - to ensure FloQast's integration strategy covers the full range of customer environments.

-
Translate SAP FI-CO process knowledge (period-end close, subledger reconciliation, journal entries, controlling) into FloQast product requirements and integration designs.

-
Partner with Engineering on technical implementation, acting as the product authority on SAP data structures, configuration dependencies, and integration constraints.

-
Engage directly with customers and partners to understand SAP-specific needs, validate integration designs, and support successful deployments.

-
Support GTM teams with the FloQast-SAP value story: what the integration enables, how it accelerates close, and where it delivers measurable value for SAP-running accounting teams.

-
Drive adoption of FloQast workflows, playbooks, and products in SAP environments - with success measured by processes running on data from SAP ERP.
What You'll Bring
- 5+ years working in an SAP FI-CO environment supporting financial close activities, in a techno-functional, product, consulting, or solution advisory capacity.

- Deep understanding of SAP FI-CO: general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, asset accounting, cost center accounting, and the period-end close cycle.

- Hands-on familiarity with SAP technical architecture: ABAP, oData services, and SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).

- Understanding of SAP deployment models - On-Premise, Private Cloud, Public Cloud (RISE/GROW), and HEC - and how each affects integration approach and data availability.

- Strong grasp of accounting processes, close cadences, and financial controls as they operate within SAP environments.

- Ability to engage at both the technical and business level: credible with Engineering on integration architecture, and persuasive with customers on process value.

- Equal comfort as a hands-on builder (requirements, integration design, specs) and a storyteller (GTM narrative, customer conversations, partner alignment).
Nice to Have
- Experience with financial close software products such as FloQast, BlackLine, or similar.

- Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA migration patterns and the differences in data model and integration approach versus ECC6.

- Product management experience in a B2B SaaS company, or experience working closely with product teams to translate SAP domain expertise into product direction.
#LI-BT1
#LI-Hybrid
